stem.x: Which of the following is a function of an IDS?

b.x: It checks whether software products that are installed on a PC are the latest version.

It collects the status of information security measures, such as the status of operations management for an information system, and also obtains company information, then performs a self-diagnosis on the status of activities for information security in an organization.
It monitors a server or a network and notifies the administrator when it has detected an intrusion or infringement.
It sends test data to a product that it examines and detects any vulnerability from the response or behavior of the product.
